announcements.headline: Notice of Half Year Results
announcements.insight: As a high-growth consumer discretionary stock, the release of half-year results is critical for validating the sustainability of its expansion strategy and unit economics amidst rising input costs and shifting consumer sentiment.

announcements.headline: Director purchase of shares
announcements.insight: Routine insider buying in the UK consumer discretionary sector often signals management confidence but lacks the transformative weight of M&A or capital raises; context is limited by the absence of deal size relative to market cap.
